title: The Canopy That Never Sleeps
timing_note: Shot allocations are first-pass editorial targets. Validate actual runtime with a timed animatic.

shots.title: NeoVan wakes
shots.visual: Aerial reveal of contemporary forest-city, living-root transit, bridges, gardens and dawn mist.
audio: Narrator: In NeoVan, the forest isn't behind us. It's the reason we built anything at all.

shots.title: The amber warning
shots.visual: Courier tram approaches a track split; amber warning indicator blinks briefly.

shots.title: Ayaan races the drone
shots.visual: Ayaan races a medicine drone, leaps a narrow gap, and lands safely.

shots.title: Choosing to help
shots.visual: Ayaan abandons the race to help an elderly vendor with a jammed cart; oranges roll.

shots.title: Friends and distant flicker
shots.visual: Friends banter; camera rises to city scale; a distant relay tower flickers before title card.

shots.title: Market life and obstacle course
shots.visual: Lively market and repair kiosks; Chiku presents a drone obstacle course.

shots.title: Course rules
shots.visual: Chiku explains rules; friends tease Ayaan; Kabir keeps him away from edge.

shots.title: Marker drift
shots.visual: Controller marker jumps unnaturally; close-ups reveal corrupted location ping.

shots.title: Five-pulse signature
shots.visual: Drone freezes; lights flash three times, pause, then twice.

shots.title: Official warning
shots.visual: Veer's public announcement; Mira spots altered maintenance sticker; friends decide to ask workshop.

shots.title: Civic operations hub
shots.visual: Functional tree-integrated control room; engineers report three relay interruptions.

shots.title: Veer's response
shots.visual: Veer orders safe routes maintained, physical checkpoints staffed, and honest updates shared.

shots.title: Kairav enters
shots.visual: Kairav enters with aides; scar over right brow and modern black coat clearly readable.

shots.title: Safety versus fear
shots.visual: Brothers debate evidence, public trust and expanded restrictions through restrained close-ups.

shots.title: Ayaan used as pressure
shots.visual: Kairav mentions Ayaan; Veer orders quiet checks; network map blinks out and returns.

shots.title: Approach under warning signs
shots.visual: Vine-reclaimed relay, dusty solar panels, humming bridge and restricted-access sign.

shots.title: The door is already open
shots.visual: Ayaan sees the door ajar; his joking expression disappears; Mira signals caution.

shots.title: Map of response times
shots.visual: Read-only diagnostic reader reveals relay response intervals and network blind spots.

shots.title: Unmarked probe
shots.visual: Unmarked device under console emits the canonical five-pulse signature while logs copy.

shots.title: Remote session active
shots.visual: Remote-session warning appears; Ayaan touches the probe and a red indicator activates.

shots.title: Station locks down
shots.visual: Door locks, maintenance drone turns toward them, Mira tries release and Ayaan finds tampered latch.

shots.title: Escape and consequence
shots.visual: Copy completes; Ayaan releases lock; drone scans and transmits as trio escapes.

shots.title: Argument beneath the roots
shots.visual: Mira confronts Ayaan; partial route identifier is confirmed; hidden lens retracts.

shots.title: Rain and accountability
shots.visual: Ayaan admits his mistake; Kabir explains shared risk; group regains trust cautiously.

shots.title: City map flickers
shots.visual: Transit screen flashes relay path; bridge lights fail and emergency strips turn muted red.

shots.title: The silhouette
shots.visual: Anonymous silhouette watches across gap and disappears into rain; Mira stops Ayaan from rushing alone.

shots.title: Watcher reports
shots.visual: Watcher reports that the boy found the probe; surveillance displays show the friends leaving.

shots.title: Kairav's final move
shots.visual: Kairav studies Veer's live image as defense markers turn from amber to red.

shots.title: Signal sting
shots.visual: Cut to black, then end card after the signal sting.
